subject: On-prem air-gapped deployment qualification - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@legacybank.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@legacybank.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: On-prem air-gapped deployment qualification - next steps

Hi Tom / Sanjay —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and the open items we agreed to validate so we can scope the PoC and procurement: 

1) Deployment mode: you confirmed the desire for a Private on-prem deployment that will be fully air-gapped (no egress). We flagged Dedicated capacity vs fully on-prem; this thread is to qualify the fully air-gapped option.

2) Hardware baseline questions:
   - GPU type/qty: you mentioned A100s; we need exact SKU (40GB vs 80GB) and how many cards per rack/node.
   - CPU, RAM, NVMe: we need NVMe scratch sizing per node (preferred minimum), RAM per GPU, and expected model sequence lengths.
   - Network: management plane needs (out-of-band), NICs, and whether we can use a restricted management VLAN for updates.

3) Offline ops and upgrades:
   - Process for model updates and runtime patches in an air-gapped environment (encrypted media, signed artifacts).
   - KMS/HSM: what key management do you have on-prem? Do you require integration with an HSM for keys/attestation?
   - Upgrade cadence and windows (how frequently do you anticipate pulling new model builds or security updates?).

4) Security/compliance evidence you asked for: SOC2 artifacts, network diagrams, and the on-prem install runbook.

Next steps I propose:
- You share the current rack inventory and exact GPU SKUs (tom).
- We'll review the hardware list and provide optimized configuration (including recommendations for quantized model variants to reduce GPU footprint).
- Schedule a 90-minute deep-dive workshop with our Solutions Engineer (Michael) to walk through install, airgap procedures, and offline update mechanics.
- Provide an initial PoC scope doc and an estimate for a sealed-media model update flow.

I attached two docs to help: redwood-onprem-hw-spec-v2.pdf (hardware guidance) and redwood-offline-updates-runbook.docx (high-level runbook).

Can you confirm the GPU SKUs and whether you have an HSM/KMS on-prem? If convenient, propose 1–2 times for the workshop next week.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: redwood-onprem-hw-spec-v2.pdf, redwood-offline-updates-runbook.docx

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@legacybank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@legacybank.com>, LegacyBank Infra <infra@legacybank.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem air-gapped deployment qualification - next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers inline and a couple of attachments from our side.

> GPU type/qty
We currently have a purchase order in flight for 8x NVIDIA A100 40GB per rack (PCIe). We are evaluating 2-node vs 3-node configurations; our initial target is a single rack PoC with 2 nodes (4 cards/node). Will send inventory CSV.

> NVMe / RAM
Each node is planned with 4TB NVMe scratch and 1.5TB RAM. We can increase NVMe if recommended. Typical sequence lengths for our LLM workloads are 1024 tokens for retrieval-augmented generation, with some batch bursts up to 2048.

> Network / airgap
We will keep the cluster fully air-gapped for inference. Management plane is via an isolated management VLAN accessible only from our on-prem jump hosts. No outbound internet.

> KMS/HSM
We have an on-prem HSM (Thales) and prefer to keep key material within it. We can provide an integration point for signing and key wrapping.

> Update cadence
Model updates: quarterly for major models, urgent patches as-needed. For initial PoC we'd like an option to apply updates via encrypted USB with signed images.

> Compliance artifacts
Attached: legacybank-current-rack-inventory.csv. Security will request SOC2 plus any install-runbook evidence.

Next for us: please share a PoC scope with the sealed-media update flow and suggested hardware tweaks (if quantization reduces GPU needs). Also propose times for the workshop — mornings PST next Tue/Wed work for me.

Thanks,
Tom Reynolds
Director, ML Infrastructure | LegacyBank
Tom.Reynolds@legacybank.com

Attachments: legacybank-current-rack-inventory.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@legacybank.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@legacybank.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem air-gapped deployment qualification - next steps

Tom —

Appreciate the detail and the inventory CSV — that helps a lot. A few quick clarifications and proposed next steps: 

- A100 40GB (PCIe) with 4TB NVMe per node is workable for a PoC. We'll provide guidance on NVMe placement and recommended scratch sizing for caching and KV.
- Given your sequence lengths and batch patterns, we can model quantized variants (int8/4) to reduce effective GPU requirements; I'll loop Michael to propose config options.
- For air-gapped updates: we support a signed-image workflow where model artifacts and runtime updates are packaged, signed by your HSM keys, and validated by the on-prem install agent. We'll document the sealed-media transfer process in the PoC scope.

Proposed PoC scope (high level) attached: proposed-poc-scope.md — includes:
  - Install and validation of Redwood Private control plane in an air-gapped rack
  - Sealed-media model update test (encrypted USB with HSM-signed manifest)
  - Performance benchmark using your typical 1024-token workloads and a small production-like prompt set
  - Security review checkpoint and handoff docs for your compliance team

Workshop: Michael (cc'd) can run a 90-minute technical deep-dive. Tom — Wed 19 May 09:00 PST or Tue 18 May 10:00 PST — which works for you?

I'll start drafting an initial hardware/quantization recommendation and a sealed-media update runbook for your security team.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-poc-scope.md

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: LegacyBank PoC next steps (air-gapped)

Michael / Vivek —

Looping you both in on the LegacyBank thread. Tom has confirmed 8x A100 40GB per rack (4x per node), 4TB NVMe, 1.5TB RAM, air-gapped management VLAN, and Thales HSM for key ops. They want sealed-media model updates (quarterly cadence).

Action items:
- Michael: please own the technical deep-dive. Prepare recommended node-level config (GPUs per node, NVMe layout, OS image — we typically suggest Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for on-prem installs), and a runbook for the sealed-media model update flow (verify signatures, checksum, local validation).
- Vivek: help with PoC logistics and times; prepare a rough cost estimate for a 6-week PoC (engineering hours + on-prem support).
- I will draft the procurement checklist and collect SOC2 + install-runbook artifacts for their security team.

Please let me know if you want me to introduce our compliance lead to their security contact. Target to have the PoC scope and HW recommendation to the customer by EOD Mon 17 May.

Thanks,
Marissa

(Internal note: do not forward the customer CSV externally beyond the SEs without an NDA.)
